description: Read an existing e-invoice into structured JSON: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF (base64), XRechnung or EN 16931 CII XML, or UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote XML. Returns number, dates, seller, buyer, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment details and notes; amounts stay strings exactly as in the XML. Does not validate (use validate_einvoice). Read-only, nothing is stored, no API key needed. Keywords: E-Rechnung auslesen, XRechnung lesen, ZUGFeRD XML extrahieren, invoice parser.

content.description: The e-invoice: a base64-encoded PDF (ZUGFeRD/Factur-X) when content_format is pdf_b64, or the XML text itself (CII or UBL, including XRechnung) when it is xml.
content.title: Content

content_format.description: pdf_b64 (default) for a base64 PDF, xml for raw XML text.
content_format.title: Content Format
